history_facts.fact: Henry Phipps established the family office Bessemer Securities in 1911 (New York); its venture group opened a Silicon Valley office in 1976 and spun out in 1981 as an independent firm, Bessemer Venture Partners.
The seventh fund (about $1B, 2007) was the first to take outside investors; before it, money came only from the Phipps family or Bessemer Securities.

Early bets: Shopify Series A (2010 memo, BVP invested $5mm), Pinterest $10M Series A led by Bessemer (2011 memo, Jeremy Levine backstory), LinkedIn (2007 round, $12.8M with European Founders Fund), Skype, Twilio, Yelp, Toast, Anthropic (2024).

Today: $20B assets under management, 155+ IPOs / deSPACs, 450+ active portfolio companies (About page); $5.75B raised in a single close announced 2026-09-22 ($1.75B seed/early, $4B growth). Form ADV 2026-05-13 regulatory assets $20,239,213,324.
Other timeline entries: India office 2006, Tel Aviv 2007, dedicated growth fund 2019, London 2021, BVP Forge 2022, $1B AI commitment 2023.
Wikipedia dates the Silicon Valley office 1975 and gives a 1974 Trust split; the firm's own timeline says 1976 and 1981. Use the firm's.
